text: An Nulaao, maakan ɓe : Hara hiɗon habbitori men si wanaa nde ballal arata men maa sahodinde?! Menen kadi meɗen faditii nde lepte Alla ɗen jippotoo e mon, immorde ka Makko, ɗe halka on maa O leptira on e juuɗe amen, men wara on men daha, si O duŋanike men warugol on. Habbitee battane amen ɗen! Menen kadi meɗen faditii battane mon ɗen.
